entities.summary: Nora Berra is a French physician and politician who served as Secretary of State for Seniors (2009–2010) and as Secretary of State for Health (2010–2012) in the government of Prime Minister François Fillon from 14 November 2010 to 10 May 2012. From 2015 until 2017, she was a member of the Republicans.
